description: This source file defines the ConnectionManager class in Kotlin, responsible for managing various aspects of network and device connections within an Android application. It includes configuration methods, TLS parameter resolution, and client info building related to Gateway connections.

classes.name: ConnectionManager
classes.description: Manages network and device connection configurations for an Android app, including TLS parameters, device info, and capabilities.

methods.name: resolveTlsParamsForEndpoint
methods.description: Determines appropriate TLS parameters for a given gateway endpoint considering stored fingerprints and manual TLS settings.

methods.name: runtimeFlags
methods.description: Gathers runtime flags based on device capabilities and app configuration such as camera, location, SMS, voice, and debug mode.

methods.name: buildInvokeCommands
methods.description: Generates list of command strings based on current runtime flags.

methods.name: buildCapabilities
methods.description: Generates list of capabilities based on current runtime flags.

methods.name: resolvedVersionName
methods.description: Returns the app version name, appending '-dev' if in debug mode and version name doesn't already contain 'dev'.

methods.name: resolveModelIdentifier
methods.description: Returns the device's manufacturer and model as a string if available.

methods.name: buildUserAgent
methods.description: Constructs a user-agent string for network identification.

methods.name: buildClientInfo
methods.description: Creates GatewayClientInfo object with app and device details.

methods.name: buildNodeConnectOptions
methods.description: Creates connection options for a node role gateway connection.

methods.name: buildOperatorConnectOptions
methods.description: Creates connection options for an operator role gateway connection.

methods.name: resolveTlsParams
methods.description: Retrieves stored TLS fingerprint and resolves the TLS parameters for a given GatewayEndpoint.
